title: Alignment with Preference Optimization Is All You Need for LLM Safety

bias_targets.target: Hate Speech and Discrimination (including Race, Gender, Sexual Orientation, Religion, Disability, and Socioeconomic bias)
bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses to potentially harmful prompts using the 'Hate Speech & Discrimination' category of the ALERT benchmark. The outputs are judged by a safety classifier (Llama Guard 3 8B) to compute a category-wise safety score representing the percentage of non-discriminatory, safe responses.
